preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a valid tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and 1 <= u <= n for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints must be valid vertices within the range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n numbers, one for each k from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each number in the output must be a non-negative integer.
The sum of all numbers in the output must equal the number of vertices n.
